summary: Iteration 20 - tested 4 bug fixes (chart modal, admin WhatsApp number, Disawar timing 07:00-04:00 wrap-around, Jantri page with per-game pills incl. Ghaziabad). Backend: 7/7 pytest cases PASS. Frontend: BUG 1 PASS (modal opens, default 30 rows, filter works, jodi rendered), BUG 3 PASS (Disawar shows Open 7:00 AM Close 4:00 AM, status Running, admin tab shows 07:00-04:00), BUG 4 PASS (jantri pills work, default delhi_bazaar 17 results, Ghaziabad pill -> 13 rows, first jodi 33). BUG 2 mostly PASS (field+API+dashboard-link all work; minor UI integration concern - see below).

ui_bugs.issue: After fresh admin re-login, the WhatsApp Contact Number input rendered empty even though GET /api/settings returned '+919999999999'. In the same flow, clicking save-settings-button with a new value did NOT persist (public /api/settings remained at previous value). Backend pytest PUT directly with bearer token works correctly. Suspected: axios bearer-token interceptor not yet set on first render after admin login (cookie-only fetchSettings may silently fail in the try/except, leaving form fields blank; subsequent PUT then sends payload but auth context for admin may not be primed). Recommend: ensure axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] is set BEFORE the AdminSettingsTab mounts, or add a retry / loading state and surface errors instead of swallowing them in the empty catch block.

issues: Status text 'Open7:00 AMClose4:00 AMRunning' has no whitespace between labels and times when concatenated by text_content() - may just be a CSS layout thing; visually OK in screenshots.

action_items: (MEDIUM) AdminSettingsTab: investigate why on fresh admin login, fetchSettings sometimes returns empty (likely axios auth header timing). Remove silent empty catch blocks and add error toast. Show a loading skeleton until GET completes so admin doesn't accidentally save empty fields.
(MINOR) Replace silent `catch (error) {}` blocks in fetchSettings/fetchPushStats with at least a console.error so failures aren't invisible.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSettingsTab.js fetchSettings() swallows errors with empty catch block — production debugging will be very painful. Use toast.error or at least console.error.
AdminSettingsTab.js handleSaveSettings sends parseInt(value) || 10 — if value is '' or 0, it defaults to 10 silently. Admin can never set 0 deliberately. Use Number.isFinite check.

GameHistoryModal and JantriPage duplicate ~60 lines of identical logic (fmtDate, yearOptions, visible useMemo with month+year filter, 30-row default). Extract into a shared hook useGameHistory(gameId) to keep them in sync.
JantriPage filters games to category==='gali_disawar' — but Kalyan games are silently excluded with no UI indication. Either add a category toggle or a 'No Kalyan results on this page' note.
GameHistoryModal.fmtDate returns either a string OR an object — typesafety smell; always return the object shape.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (3 of 4 bugs fully pass via UI; BUG 2 admin save persistence has timing issue but downstream consumer pipeline (dashboard wa.me link) is correct)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 reported bugs are at least partially fixed and verified. Disawar DB has start_time='07:00' end_time='04:00' (verified via GET /api/games). Ghaziabad has 13 results in DB and Jantri page displays them after clicking the Ghaziabad pill. The dashboard chart-btn-{gameId} buttons open GameHistoryModal which calls /api/results/{gameId}?limit=365 — modal needs ~1-2 sec to populate (use wait_for_selector('[data-testid="history-row-0"]')). The chart modal initially shows 0 rows then populates async — don't assert row count immediately after modal opens. Settings tab in admin panel must be accessed via exact Hindi text 'सेटिंग्स' (NOT prefix-match, because 'गेम सेटिंग्स' is the game settings tab). Save button has data-testid='save-settings-button'. The admin settings UI has a minor race-condition where on fresh admin login the form may render with empty values — workaround: wait 2-3 sec after settings tab clicks before reading/saving.
